question.text:
What is the inverse of the matrix $A$ given by:

$$
A=\left[\begin{array}{lll}
1 & 0 & 0 \\
2 & 1 & 0 \\
0 & 0 & 1
\end{array}\right]
$$

  1. $A^{-1}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]$
     
  2. $A^{-1}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]$
     
  3. $A^{-1}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 1\end{array}\right]$
     
  4. $A^{-1}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]$
question.subject: Linear Algebra
